stem.text: The variation with distance $x$ of the displacement $y$ of a transverse wave on a rope is shown at time $t = 0$.
The wave has a frequency of $0.5\,\text{Hz}$.
A point P on the rope is marked. The diagram shows the original position of P and four new positions.
What is the position of P at time $t = 1\,\text{s}$?

stem.alt: Graph of displacement y against distance x for a transverse wave, with the axes labelled y and x and origin marked 0; an arrow labelled direction of wave travel is shown above the x-axis, and points labelled P, A, B, C and D are marked as dots.
